Back in the early ’90s, Michigan basketball had the most iconic team in college basketball: the Fab Five.Chris Webber. Jalen Rose. Juwan Howard. Jimmy King. Ray Jackson.They took over the sport and changed the game. Baggy shorts. Black socks. They had swagger that college basketball had never seen before.They went to back-to-back national championship games, but they famously never won the title.Decades later, a different Michigan team took the reins.Led by Yaxel Lendeborg and a dominant frontcourt, the 2025-26 Wolverines didn’t carry quite the same hype.
